messages:
alyssa (support): customer reports redeemed voucher via webflow, got the confirmation email but their account balance still shows 0. org: org_2371, acct: acct_9. Can someone triage?

ben (support): can you paste the webhook payload / id and customer email so I can check delivery + ledger?

alyssa (support): payload below, webhook id wh_01HABC, email cust+trial@example.com
```json
{"event":"redeem","code":"WELCOME2025","amount_cents":5000,"org":"org_2371","email":"cust+trial@example.com","webhook_id":"wh_01HABC"}
```

ben (support): webhook shows delivered to ingestion endpoint. Running quick ledger query now: `SELECT * FROM credits WHERE org='org_2371' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5` -> returns no rows. tagging @javier-billing to check apply pipeline.

javier-billing: on it. I see the webhook hit our queue and the ingest_job processed, but the apply step returned 409 on idempotency check because grant_id was missing from the payload mapping. Downstream retry did not enqueue due to a bug in the mapping layer.

alyssa (support): customer is on trial and blocked from creating API keys until credits show. They need a manual fix ASAP.

javier-billing: I can do a manual grant. Planned action: insert a credit row and mark webhook processed. Command (internal): `ledger.insert_credit(org='org_2371', amount_cents=5000, reason='manual_grant:wh_01HABC')` then `ingest.mark_processed(whid='wh_01HABC')`. ETA ~20m. Also filing a follow-up to prevent silent idempotency failures.

nia-eng: I'll open infra ticket to add an alert when ``ingest.processed=true`` but no matching `credits` row is created. Filing infra#3947 and adding a short-term synthetic to watch for this pattern.

ben (support): thanks all — @alyssa please standby and update customer when you see the ledger-bot confirmation. :thumbsup:

ledger-bot: Manual grant completed by javier-billing id=grat_9092 amount_cents=5000 org=org_2371 timestamp=1956787745

alyssa (support): confirmed with customer — balance now shows 50 credits. Closing the escalation.

javier-billing: follow-up notes: root cause = mapping service dropped `grant_id` on this partner webhook variant. Patch PR prepared to default grant_id and requeue on mapping mismatch.

nia-eng: infra#3947 created: monitor + alert + runbook.

ben (support): closing thread, leaving notes on the support ticket.
